avatarText: Responsable RSE dans une maison de luxe. Veut associer la marque à des femmes leaders de la culture et de la création. Craint le greenwashing et veut des preuves d'impact concret. Sensible aux partenariats qui renforcent la marque employeur et l'image auprès d'une clientèle exigeante.

speaker.name: Coralie Marabelle
speaker.info: Fondatrice de Wise Women, Wise Women — 10-line brief:  Founded 2017, structured as a loi 1901 association since 2019. A curated network of 100+ senior women in arts and creative industries, plus a 200-person extended network. Core fields: contemporary art, fashion & design, cinema & image, edition & media. Mission: unite women engaged in culture and creation, strengthen visibility of their professions, amplify their work's impact, and transmit expertise to the next generation. Flagship program: Appel à Projets, an annual competition supporting young female artists. Current fundraising: ~€18,000/year from 3 sponsors, sourced entirely through personal connections — no proactive outreach has ever been run. President: Coralie. Tax status: eligible under loi Mécénat 2003, giving corporate donors a 60% deduction (net cost = 40% of donation). Partnership philosophy: values-first and selective — won't partner on budget alone; requires genuine alignment on women's empowerment, cultural credibility, and brand prestige. Existing prospect list: ~55 companies in fashion, beauty, design, and art, compiled from memory — no enrichment or scoring done yet.
